name: Sugar Break
summary: Take a break from sugar for a month or any length you choose, tap +1 each time you skip it, and watch your sugar-free days and streak on the web, desktop, or iPhone, with Apple Health sugar shown beside each day.

screenshots.alt: Sugar Break page on day 10 of a 30-day break with a +1 I skipped sugar button, 9 sugar-free days, a 4-day streak, and a day grid

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

config.title: Sugar Break
config.description: Start a sugar break, one month by default, and tap +1 every time you skip sugar.
